spans.text: Bang bang bang! Bullets hit the ground behind us. While we're still outside of accurate firing distance, our pursuers are clearly about to catch up to us.
Dandelion!
Dandelion takes control of the closest Paradeus troops chasing us.
It's obvious that her stamina is being taxed to its limits.
I'll take you all on! Rip and tear!
SOP-II! Don't be reckless!
Any rounds left, RO?
The AR Team is deep within the enemy formation and on the verge of being overrun. If I can't think of a way to get us out of this, they'll swamp us all...
Greetings, Commander.
Who's that?!
We're out of rounds and they've even hacked our comms?!
Please do not worry. We are Squad Griffin, sent here to pick you up in accordance with the mission directives.
Allow me to introduce myself. I am VP1915 Villar Perosa, but you can call me Perosa.
So we DO have a pickup!
How can you prove that?
The Earl said that you would understand once you saw this seal.
Perosa holds a wax seal up to the communicator.
It is imprinted with the image of a mighty griffin baring its claws, surrounded by intricate designs.
It is exactly like the one on the mission document I received.
...So it's the Earl. I see.
According to the intel provided by the Earl, these Paradeus forces are only active on the outskirts of the city. They seem to be prohibited from entering the city area.
Derringer and Savage are coming over to support you. I will guide you remotely to help you shake off your pursuers.
Alright, so those two—
Bang bang bang—
Just as the Commander contemplates their next move, the sound of unfamiliar gunfire erupts from behind them.
I'm picking up IFF signals belonging to two high-end I.O.P. Dolls, but they're not on the Griffin base roster.
Hi, Commander~ This doesn't seem like the best time for a chat...
We're here to lend you a hand, Commander.
They've arrived, Commander. Now, please run toward the slope at 1 o'clock as quickly as you can.
They're only two Dolls, will they be alright?
Please have faith in my judgment.
The two unfamiliar Dolls exchange smiles. Their fighting stances show that they are fully in sync with each other.
Leave this place to us!
Please do as Perosa directs and head into the city proper.
...Got it.
Let's not waste any more time. Everyone, to the city!
...In a hidden patch of forest.
A petite figure grits her teeth as she watches the Commander's party flee to the city area with the help of Squad Griffin.
What?! They're fleeing in that direction... But Big Sis won't let me go there!
They're going to escape, just like that... And all I can do is watch...
Why is this happening? (Sobs)
How am I going to explain this to Big Sis? How—
They are about to enter the city. Shall we continue giving chase?
The girl turns and sends the white Nyto flying with a slap.
The black Nyto standing beside her trembles in fear, not daring to look at the white Nyto's head as it rolls past her feet.
Chase?! You're nothing but a pack of stupid dogs, all you can do is bark and chase!
Hurry up and find out who the hell met up with them!
After not getting a response for a long time, the girl angrily picks up the white Nyto's corpse.
What's the matter, cat got your— Huh? Where's the head?
Trash is trash. One slap and your head's gone.
The girl disdainfully discards the white Nyto's corpse. The black Nyto standing nearby falls to her knees and dares not move.
You.
Y-Yes...?
Do you know your mission?
Yes, I do!
Make sure you do a good job and don't disappoint me, or else...
The girl pats the black Nyto on the head jovially.
...I-I won't disappoint you!
The black Nyto practically flees from her, leaving the little girl to glare at the Commander's group as they recede into the distance.
Not bad. You're pretty pathetic in a fight, but you do run very fast.
But don't get too cocky, we'll meet again.
And when we do, I'm going to twist your spine into a pretzel...
